purpose: Retain registered FORS-target control path for timing, restore original latency for controls not actually consuming that read-only source.

slow_selection.BR: DST unless ALWAYS; register SRC only for comparison conditions EQ/NE/LT/GE/SIBLING/SAME_PARENT with register RHS(aux=0)

timing_boundaries: FORS extraction ends at staged_control_{dst,src,aux}. ALU/address compute ends at control_result/control_address. Checked arithmetic/memory commit uses those registers. Slow BR ends at control_branch_result before completion handshake.
branch_handshake: slow_control is selected at control acceptance and retained through WAIT_CONTROL consumption; selecting slow condition does not depend on executor remaining in CONTROL_EXEC. Next accepted instruction chooses its own path. Fast BR completes as original with live operands, consumed by unchanged c sequencer WAIT_CONTROL one clock later.
load_store: Fast LOAD registers the live checked-range address in FETCH; slow LOAD registers its retained address in CONTROL_COMMIT. Both write output context only in CONTROL_LOAD after checks. STORE only enables endpoint writes after execute_control checks and entry to CONTROL_STORE; address mux retains live fast vs registered slow address.
side_effect_checks: Arithmetic bounds/masks/overflow, RAM address, selector, input/output and branch legality guards remain in execute_control. Slow BR retains its identical guards in CONTROL_EXEC.
reset: Staged banks/address/result/branch flag all reset in original core reset branch. Invalid controls cannot reach architectural write states before checks.

supplemental.scope: 10 cases/view: slow FORS BR on each operand, MOV/ADD plus overflow and readonly rejection, LOAD/STORE RAM107 acceptance and108 rejection/no partial side effects, ignored FORS fields stay fast; no Hash or tree computation.
